name: Jinan Acetate Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinan Acetate Chemical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of cellulose acetate, acetate tows, acetic anhydride, diacetate fiber filament, diacetate fiber tow, and other related products in Asia, Europe, America, and Africa. The company also engages in investment activities. Its products are used in cigarette filters, fountain pen refills, and absorbent layers for diapers and masks. Jinan Acetate Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.
